params.intro_en: COR + OR = REEF is a 4-digit sum, so R=1 (carry from hundreds). Work column by column.

items.text_en: R=1 (the result is 4 digits, so the hundreds column carries 1 into thousands, meaning R=1).
items.text_id: R=1 (hasilnya 4 digit, sehingga kolom ratusan menyimpan 1 ke ribuan, artinya R=1).

items.text_en: Units column: R + R = F (no carry out since F is units of REEF). 1+1=2, so F=2, carry=0.
items.text_id: Kolom satuan: R + R = F (tidak ada simpanan keluar karena F adalah satuan REEF). 1+1=2, jadi F=2, simpanan=0.

items.text_en: Tens column: O + O + carry_from_units = E (tens of REEF) + 10×carry_to_hundreds. carry_from_units=0, so 2O = 10×c2 + E. For E to be a single digit and 2O≥10 (so c2=1): 2O≥10 → O≥5.
items.text_id: Kolom puluhan: O + O + simpanan_dari_satuan = E (puluhan REEF) + 10×simpanan_ke_ratusan. simpanan_dari_satuan=0, jadi 2O = 10×c2 + E. Agar E satu digit dan 2O≥10 (c2=1): 2O≥10 → O≥5.

items.text_en: Hundreds column: C + O + c2 = 10×R + E (hundreds and thousands of REEF, with R=1 in thousands). So C + O + 1 = 10 + E.
items.text_id: Kolom ratusan: C + O + c2 = 10×R + E (ratusan dan ribuan REEF, dengan R=1 di ribuan). Jadi C + O + 1 = 10 + E.

items.text_en: Try O=9: 2×9=18 → E=8, c2=1. Hundreds: C+9+1=10+8 → C=8. But C=E=8, digits clash. Wrong.

items.text_en: Try O=5, recheck columns carefully. COR is hundreds+tens+units = 100C+10O+R. OR = 10O+R. Sum = 100C+20O+2R = 100C+20O+2 (R=1). REEF = 1000R+100E+10E+F = 1000+110E+2.
items.text_id: Coba O=5, periksa ulang kolom dengan hati-hati. COR = 100C+10O+R. OR = 10O+R. Jumlah = 100C+20O+2R = 100C+20O+2 (R=1). REEF = 1000R+100E+10E+F = 1000+110E+2.
Jadi 100C+20O+2 = 1002+110E. Dengan O=5: 100C+100+2=1002+110E → 100C=900+110E → C=(9+1.1E). E harus membuat C bilangan bulat: E=0 → C=9. Periksa: C=9,O=5,R=1,E=0,F=2, semua berbeda ✓.

hint_steps_en: The result REEF is 4 digits, so adding a 3-digit and 2-digit number produces a carry into thousands. This means R = 1.
Units column: R + R = 1 + 1 = 2, so F = 2 with no carry.
Tens column: O + O = 2O must carry (to make REEF 4-digit). Try O = 5: 2×5 = 10, so E = 0, carry = 1.
Hundreds column: C + O + carry = 10 + E (since R=1 in thousands). C + 5 + 1 = 10 + 0 → C = 4... but re-expanding: 100C + 20×5 + 2 = 1002 + 110×0 → 100C = 900 → C = 9.
Verify: COR = 951, OR = 51. 951 + 51 = 1002. All digits C=9, O=5, R=1, E=0, F=2 are different ✓. REEF = 1002.
